# Factur-X Engine — complete machine-readable product context

Factur-X Engine is a self-hosted Docker API for technical electronic-invoice
workflows. It processes supported Factur-X/ZUGFeRD CII and XRechnung UBL
documents without sending invoice payloads to a Factur-X Engine hosted service.
The operator remains responsible for network isolation, access control, logs,
storage and deployment security.

Repository: https://github.com/facturx-engine/facturx-engine
Documentation: https://facturx-engine.github.io/facturx-engine/
OpenAPI: https://facturx-engine.github.io/facturx-engine/openapi.json
Strict schema v2: https://facturx-engine.github.io/facturx-engine/schemas/serialize-response.v2.schema.json
Free 30-day Intake evaluation: https://facturx-engine.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/99a9ff62-baa6-4a24-ac61-3eebfacddab5

## Responsibility boundary

Factur-X Engine is a document-processing component. An API success is not tax,
accounting, legal, regulatory or security advice. It is not a guarantee that a
recipient, portal, auditor or tax authority will accept a document.

Validation results describe only the rules and tools that actually ran. Always
inspect:

- `validation_completeness`
- `layers_executed`
- `layers_skipped`
- `pdfa_valid` when PDF/A evidence is relevant

The caller retains at least these controls:

- supplier-master matching
- duplicate-invoice detection
- purchase-order matching
- tax-policy decisions
- payment approval
- filing, reporting and recipient-acceptance decisions

## Runtime

Community quickstart:

    docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name facturx-engine \
      facturxengine/facturx-engine:latest

Intake evaluation:

    docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name facturx-engine \
      -e LICENSE_KEY='YOUR_EVALUATION_KEY' \
      facturxengine/facturx-engine:latest

Runtime API documentation is available at `http://localhost:8000/docs`.
`GET /license/status` reports whether the key was accepted without exposing it.

Do not expose an unauthenticated container directly to the public internet. Use
an authenticated reverse proxy or a private network.

## Receive-invoice endpoints

### POST /v1/validate

Accepts a supported PDF or XML invoice and runs the validation layers available
in the container. The response reports detected format and profile, errors,
validation completeness, and executed or skipped layers.

Community returns structured validation errors. An Evaluation or Pro key also
enables enhanced human-readable diagnostics. For PDF inputs, the VeraPDF layer
is run only when the licensed feature is enabled, VeraPDF is available and the
request/configuration has not disabled it.

Do not interpret `valid: true` without inspecting validation completeness and
skipped layers.

### POST /v1/extract

Returns a best-effort inspection preview of an embedded invoice. Every response
declares:

    "mode": "preview"
    "suitable_for_automatic_import": false

Extraction may expose missing, coerced or truncated values. Do not use it as an
automatic accounting-import decision and do not describe it as repairing an
invoice.

### POST /v1/serialize — Factur-X Engine Intake

Requires an Evaluation or Pro key. It accepts a raw supported CII/UBL XML
invoice or a PDF containing supported invoice XML.

A successful response means:

- the configured validation completed and passed;
- XML parsing did not use tolerant recovery;
- required mapped values were not invented;
- supported material groups were not silently skipped;
- arithmetic and contract invariants passed;
- the result conforms to strict response schema version `2.0.0`.

Example success metadata:

    {
      "success": true,
      "schema_version": "2.0.0",
      "execution_status": "complete",
      "mapping_status": "complete",
      "validation_status": "passed",
      "suggested_route": "continue_client_checks",
      "client_checks_required": [
        "supplier_master_match",
        "duplicate_invoice_check",
        "purchase_order_match",
        "tax_policy_check",
        "payment_approval"
      ]
    }

Malformed, invalid, incomplete or unsupported documents return HTTP 422 with
stable diagnostics containing `code`, `source`, `path` and `message`. Intake
prefers an explicit refusal over a plausible partial invoice.

Without a qualifying key, `/v1/serialize` returns HTTP 403 with
`FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED`.

## Send-invoice endpoints

### POST /v1/xml

Generates supported CII XML from the documented metadata model. Generation is
not proof that every validation applicable to a recipient has run.

### POST /v1/convert

Generates CII XML from metadata and embeds it in a supplied PDF. Validate the
result separately when XSD, Schematron or PDF/A evidence is required.

### POST /v1/merge

Embeds an existing supported XML document into a supplied PDF/A-3 container.
It does not transform arbitrary source XML into a different invoice syntax.
Validate the resulting artifact separately.

## Operations endpoints

- `GET /health`: lightweight liveness probe
- `GET /healthz`: readiness and validation-tool availability
- `GET /license/status`: license tier and expiry without the key value
- `GET /diagnostics`: protected runtime diagnostics; configure a token outside development
- `GET /metrics`: protected Prometheus output when explicitly enabled

## Commercial and licensing status

All code published in the repository is MIT licensed. Community and Intake use
the same repository and public Docker image. A key controls packaged feature
availability; it does not reduce MIT rights over published source code.

Factur-X Engine Intake is currently a controlled product and price test:

- free evaluation: 30 days
- proposed price: €299 excluding VAT, paid once
- scope: one legal entity, internal use on its own infrastructure
- no per-invoice licence fee
- no public paid checkout currently active

The proposed scope excludes:

- redistribution and OEM use
- embedding in a customer-facing SaaS
- SLA or guaranteed response times
- priority or custom support
- bespoke mappings, integration or development
- tax, accounting, legal or regulatory advice
- conformity or recipient-acceptance guarantees

No payment should be collected until final commercial terms and vendor details
have been reviewed and activated.
